asr_text: My wife said, Take me anywhere. Then she pointed at me. Kill that man. He pushed her away and asked me whether she should live or die. For that I almost forgave him, but she fled. He cut one rope and left. I rose from the cedar and picked up the small dagger she had dropped. I stabbed myself in the chest. The thicket fell silent, then someone crept towards me on soft feet. Some unseen hand quietly drew the dagger from my chest. I sunk forever into the darkness.
